Title: Register login and verify profile
Preconditions: Browser open; unique email available; UI https://practicesoftwaretesting.com/
TestSteps:
1. Open Toolshop home page
2. Navigate to Sign in then Register
3. Fill all required registration fields with valid unique data and submit
4. Sign in with the same email and password
5. Open My Account / Profile and verify displayed name and email
TestData: firstName=Avinash; lastName=Kumar; email=qa.test+{timestamp}@example.com; password=ValidPass@123; DOB and address filled
ExpectedResult: Registration succeeds; login succeeds; profile shows registered first name last name and email
ActualResult: Registration login and profile verified as expected

Title: Login fails with wrong password
Preconditions: Registered or known customer account exists
TestSteps:
1. Open Sign in page
2. Enter a valid registered email
3. Enter an incorrect password
4. Submit login
ExpectedResult: Login is rejected; user remains unauthenticated; clear error message is shown; no access to protected account pages
ActualResult: Login rejected with error; no session created

Title: COD checkout generates invoice Confirm twice
TestSteps:
1. Browse home and open a product
2. Add product to cart
3. Open cart and proceed to checkout
4. Proceed to address step and fill billing address
5. Proceed to payment and select Cash on Delivery
6. Press Confirm once then Confirm again (required to generate invoice)
7. Open My Invoices and verify the new invoice
ExpectedResult: Order completes; invoice is generated after second Confirm; invoice appears under My Invoices
ActualResult: Invoice generated after Confirm x2 and visible under My Invoices

Title: Multi-item cart with quantity update
Preconditions: Logged-in customer; at least two products available
TestSteps:
1. Add first product to cart
2. Return to home and add a second product to cart
3. Open cart and increase quantity of one line item
4. Verify cart line count and updated quantity before checkout
TestData: Two distinct products; quantity updated to 2 on one line
ExpectedResult: Cart shows multiple items; quantity reflects the update; totals recalculate accordingly
ActualResult: Multi-item cart and quantity update verified

Title: Register rejects invalid email format
TestSteps:
1. Open Register page
2. Fill required fields using an invalid email format
3. Attempt to submit registration
ExpectedResult: Registration is blocked or shows validation error; account is not created
ActualResult: Invalid email rejected with validation feedback

Title: Checkout blocks empty required billing fields
Preconditions: Logged-in user with item in cart; on checkout address step
TestSteps:
1. Add a product and proceed to checkout address step
2. Leave required billing fields empty (street city postal code)
3. Attempt to proceed to payment
ExpectedResult: User cannot proceed; validation messages shown for required fields
ActualResult: Proceed blocked until required address fields are filled

Title: Register login and create cart
Preconditions: API base https://api.practicesoftwaretesting.com; unique user payload
TestSteps:
1. POST /users/register with unique user
2. POST /users/login with same credentials and capture Bearer token
3. POST /carts with Authorization Bearer token
ExpectedResult: Register returns 201; login returns 200 with access token; cart create returns 201 with cart id
ActualResult: Automation passed — auth and cart creation succeeded

Title: Products cart verify and COD invoice
Preconditions: Valid Bearer token flow from register/login
TestSteps:
1. Register and login to obtain Bearer token
2. GET /products and select first product id
3. POST /carts then POST /carts/{id} to add product quantity 1
4. GET /carts/{id} and verify cart_items
5. POST /invoices with cash-on-delivery billing payload and cart_id
TestData: payment_method=cash-on-delivery; billing fields from payloadBuilder; cart_id from create cart
ExpectedResult: Products 200; add-to-cart 200; cart has item; invoice 201 with invoice_number
ActualResult: Automation passed — COD invoice created with invoice_number
